examples.text: Alle Mädchen erhoben sich und knicksten zur Begrüßung.

glosses: A small bow, generally performed by a woman or a girl, where she crosses the shin of one leg behind the calf of her other leg and briefly bends her knees to lower her body in deference.

examples.text: I refused to make so much as a curtsey for the passing nobles, as I am a staunch egalitarian.
